# YMU — YimMenuUpdater

> YMU (YimMenuUpdater) is a free, source-available Windows launcher, updater, and native Win32 DLL injector for Grand Theft Auto V modding, supporting both YimMenu (GTA V Legacy) and YimMenuV2 (GTA V Enhanced).

YMU is licensed under the PolyForm Shield License 1.0.0 (source-available, free for non-competitive use; not OSI-approved open source). The downstream mod menus it manages—YimMenu (Legacy) and YimMenuV2 (Enhanced)—are independent open-source projects.

## Capabilities & Architecture (v1.2.0)

- **Dual-Edition Architecture**: Full support for both GTA V Legacy (`YimMenu.dll`) and GTA V Enhanced (`YimMenuV2.dll`) with independent game directories, custom DLL paths, independent configurations, and automatic edition detection.
- **Automated Downloads & Integrity Verification**: Direct downloads from official GitHub release channels with automated SHA-256 checksum verification to protect against corrupted or tampered binaries. (Current `YMU.exe` v1.2.0 SHA-256: `72389398346378578757e6fdba9693323f157af71b01c2b3284e8b26385a64d4`).
- **BattlEye Anti-Cheat & FSL Detection**: Smart BattlEye anti-cheat service detection with a one-click `-nobattleye` toggle for `commandline.txt` (featuring seamless in-place UAC elevation if required), plus FSL loader detection (`WINMM.dll` vs deprecated `version.dll`).
- **Native Win32 UTF-16 Injection Engine**: Built with native Win32 Ctypes (`LoadLibraryW` with UTF-16 encoding) ensuring seamless injection across non-ASCII/Unicode directory paths (German Umlauts, Cyrillic, Turkish, and CJK characters) and robust post-injection module verification via `EnumProcessModulesEx`.
- **Lua Script Manager & Diagnostics**: Built-in manager for Lua scripts featuring one-click Safe Mode (instant disable/enable of all scripts), pointer and offset cache cleaning, and direct access to menu log files for rapid troubleshooting.
- **16 UI Localizations with Full RTL**: Complete interface localization across 16 languages with bidirectional Right-to-Left (RTL) support (including Arabic) and adaptive Dark/Light themes.
